ex.t: 被称为激素的身体化学物质水平的变化，不仅让青少年身体发育出成人特征，还让他们在晚上11点前难以入睡。

ex.s: And because the process of recycling steel is less polluting than making new steel, we’ve also achieved the following significant savings; in energy use—47% to 74%; in air pollution—85%; in water pollution—35%; in water use—40%.
ex.t: 而且因为回收钢比制造新钢污染更少，我们还取得了以下显著节约：能源使用——47%到74%；空气污染——85%；水污染——35%；用水——40%。

ex.s: A local driving school has also offered him six    55    driving lessons.
ex.t: 当地一所驾校还为他提供了六节____55____驾驶课。

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为十几岁时几____58____（month 个月）的锻炼就足以____59____（受益）余生，建立词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己拥有出色的词汇量。

ex.s: They have also bought for some gardening tools.
ex.t: 他们还买了一些园艺工具。

ex.s: It turns out that baby red-backed fairy wrens also emerge chirping like their moms.
ex.t: 结果发现，红背细尾鹩莺幼鸟孵化出来时也会像妈妈一样啁啾。

ex.s: The purchase price could also be a signal that an established company is buying a new-born threat.
ex.t: 收购价格也可能是一个信号，表明一家老牌公司在收购一个新生威胁。

ex.s: But he is also working at a far more fundamental level: his staff show people how to make floating gardens and fish ponds prevent starvation during the wet season.
ex.t: 但是,他也在更根本的层面上工作:他的工作人员向人们展示如何在潮湿的季节使漂浮的花园和鱼塘防止饥饿。

ex.s: Farmers in many countries are also adapting like this—either by growing new produce, or by growing the same things differently.
ex.t: 许多国家的农民也在这样适应——要么种植新的农产品，要么用不同的方式种植同样的东西。

ex.s: Their research also suggests how we may build lasting memories over time even though the synapses become thinner.
ex.t: 他们的研究也揭示了我们如何能在突触变细的情况下随着时间建立持久的记忆。

ex.s: We should also try to sleep well the night before.
ex.t: 我们也应该在前一天晚上尽量睡好。

ex.s: These activities not only help them gain more skills, managing their time.Listen again but also teach them to care about others.
ex.t: 这些活动不仅帮助他们获得更多技能、管理时间，再听一遍，而且还教会他们关心他人。

ex.s: After-school activities also play a part when students apply to college.
ex.t: 课后活动在学生申请上大学时也起到一定的作用.

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 您还必须惊讶于一种独特的疯狂语言，在这种语言中，房子可以在燃烧时燃烧，您可以通过填写表格来填写表格，并且只有在警报响起时才会听到警报！

ex.s: The Americans and the British also use different words for everyday things.
ex.t: 美国人和英国人对日常事物也使用不同的词汇。

ex.s: Grandfather: (turning to Son) Why don't you also take my advice and think carefully before jumping in with both feet?
ex.t: 祖父：（转向儿子）你为什么不也听我的建议，在全力投入之前仔细想想？
